planets.name: K2-31 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-31 with a 1.26-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-31 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-31. Its orbit and size follow Grziwa et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
